The code currently declares package then @ExtendWith before imports. The @ExtendWith annotation must be placed on class, after imports. So we need to move imports above the class definition, then annotate class.

Also need to add necessary imports for mockito annotations: org.mockito.Mock; org.mockito.Mockito; org.mockito.InOrder; org.mockito.MockitoAnnotations? But using @Mock with MockitoExtension, no need for init.

Also need to import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*; static org.mockito.Mockito.*; static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.*; maybe.

Also need to import com.networknt.schema.* classes: ExecutionContext, ExecutionContextCustomizer, OutputFormat, ValidationMessage, FailFastAssertionException, JsonSchema, JsonNodePath, SchemaLocation, ValidationContext, JsonSchema (already same package). Since test is in same package, can reference without import, but better to import.

Also need to import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach, Test, DisplayName, etc.

class JsonSchema_validate_13_Test { ... }

Also need to ensure we have the necessary static imports for Mockito's any, eq, isNull, etc. Use import static org.mockito.Mockito.*; import static org.mockito.ArgumentMatchers.*; import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

Now check code for any other errors: In test validate_withoutCustomizer, there is line:

when(outputFormat.format(eq(schemaSpy), eq(dummyMessages), eq(executionContext), eq(validationContext))).// any object to prove the flow works
        thenReturn(42);

The comment after method call and before thenReturn is placed after a dot and comment; that's invalid. The line has a stray comment after the method call with a dot. Should be:

when(outputFormat.format(eq(schemaSpy), eq(dummyMessages), eq(executionContext), eq(validationContext)))
        .thenReturn(42);

Remove comment.

Actually they are stubbing the same method they are testing (validate). However they also have spy; but they stub internal validate method that takes ExecutionContext and JsonNode (the same signature as public validate?). In JsonSchema class there is overloaded validate method with OutputFormat etc. The internal one is probably private method? But they stub it; compile okay.
